title: Harry Turner, UFO-obsessed intelligence chief over Woomera nuclear tests

tellings.quote: There's Woomera test range which um the head of the nuclear division actually in Australia, the joint intelligence organization was a guy named Harry Turner, and he was obsessed with UFOs.

plain: Harry Turner, said to head the nuclear division of Australia's Joint Intelligence Organisation, the country's defence intelligence agency, was obsessed with UFOs. Michels says Turner's area covered the Woomera test range, a large Australian weapons testing site, and tells it himself without naming a source. He raises it as one more link between UFOs and nuclear sites, in an episode with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel.
